failures.question: 复购率是多少？（下单 2 次及以上的用户占全部下单用户的比例）
failures.generatedSql:
WITH per_user AS (
  SELECT c.customer_unique_id, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_cnt
  FROM orders o
  JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
  WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')
  GROUP BY 1
)
ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE order_cnt >= 2) / COUNT(*), 2) AS repeat_rate_pct
FROM per_user;

  SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT oi.product_id) AS n
